text: White's 59.axb5 fights back, though Black still keeps a decisive advantage (-31.56 → -28.96, Stockfish:16). The line [pv:axb5 Kd6 b6 Bc5+ Kd3] wins the b-pawn and pushes b6, yet after ...Kd6 Black is set to begin the king march, and Bc5+ forces the white king back to d3. Kd3 at the outset is a comparable option that also leaves Black with a decisive advantage [pv:Kd3 Kd6 c7 Rc5 c8=Q].
